note: Max rank only. The simulator runs at level 60, and a talent tooltip shows rank 1 of the ability it grants -- see docs/class-implementation.md.

spells.name: Battle Shout
spells.description: The warrior shouts, increasing the melee attack power of all party members within 20 yards by 139. Lasts 3 min.

spells.name: Battle Stance
spells.description: A balanced combat stance.

spells.name: Berserker Rage
spells.description: The warrior enters a berserker rage, becoming immune to Fear and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage. Lasts 10 sec.

spells.name: Berserker Stance
spells.description: An aggressive stance. Critical strike chance increased by 3% and all damage taken is increased by 10%.

spells.name: Bloodrage
spells.description: Generates 10 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.

spells.name: Bloodthirst
spells.description: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 48 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

spells.name: Challenging Shout
spells.description: Forces all nearby enemies within 10 yards to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

spells.name: Charge
spells.description: Charge an enemy, generate 15 Rage, and Stun it for 1 sec. Cannot be used in combat.

spells.name: Cleave
spells.description: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 50 to the target and a second nearby enemy.

spells.name: Concussion Blow
spells.description: Stuns the target for 5 sec.

spells.name: Death Wish
spells.description: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

spells.name: Defensive Stance
spells.description: A defensive combat stance. Decreases damage taken by 10% and damage caused by 10%. Increases all threat generated by 30%.

spells.name: Demoralizing Shout
spells.description: Reduces the melee attack power of all enemies within 10 yards by 204 for 45 sec.

spells.name: Disarm
spells.description: Disarm the enemy's weapon for 10 sec.

spells.name: Execute
spells.description: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 600 damage and converting each extra point of rage into 15 additional damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

spells.name: Hamstring
spells.description: Maims the enemy, causing 45 damage and slowing the enemy's movement by 50% for 15 sec.

spells.name: Heroic Strike
spells.description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 157 and causes a high amount of threat.

spells.name: Intercept
spells.description: Charge an enemy, causing 65 damage and stunning it for 3 sec.

spells.name: Intimidating Shout
spells.description: The warrior shouts, causing the targeted enemy to cower in fear. Up to 5 enemies within 8 yds will flee in fear. Lasts 8 sec.

spells.name: Last Stand
spells.description: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

spells.name: Mocking Blow
spells.description: A mocking attack that causes 93 damage, a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

spells.name: Mortal Strike
spells.description: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 160 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

spells.name: Overpower
spells.description: Instantly overpower the enemy, causing weapon damage plus 35. Only useable after the target dodges. The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried.

spells.name: Piercing Howl
spells.description: Causes all enemies within 10 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

spells.name: Pummel
spells.description: Pummel the target for 50 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

spells.name: Recklessness
spells.description: The warrior will gain 100% increased critical strike chance and will be immune to Fear effects for the next 15 sec, but all damage taken is increased by 20%.

spells.name: Rend
spells.description: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 147 damage over 21 sec.

spells.name: Retaliation
spells.description: Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you in melee for 15 sec. Melee attacks made from behind cannot be counterattacked. A maximum of 30 attacks will cause retaliation.

spells.name: Revenge
spells.description: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 138 to 168 damage and a high amount of threat. Revenge must follow a block, dodge or parry.

spells.name: Shield Bash
spells.description: Bashes the target with your shield for 45 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec.

spells.name: Shield Block
spells.description: Increases chance to block by 75% for 7 sec, but will only block 2 attacks.

spells.name: Shield Slam
spells.description: Slam the target with your shield, causing 640 to 670 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.

spells.name: Shield Wall
spells.description: Reduces the damage taken from all attacks by 60% for 12 sec.

spells.name: Slam
spells.description: Slams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 87.

spells.name: Spearing Strike
spells.description: A brutal attack that deals 40% weapon damage, plus an additional 80% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets.

spells.name: Sunder Armor
spells.description: Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 450 per Sunder Armor and causes a high amount of threat. Can be applied up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

spells.name: Sweeping Strikes
spells.description: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

spells.name: Tactical Mastery
spells.description: You retain up to 10 Rage when you change Stances.

spells.name: Taunt
spells.description: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

spells.name: Thunder Clap
spells.description: Blasts nearby enemies with thunder, increasing the time between their attacks by 20% for 30 sec and doing 103 damage to them. Will affect up to 4 targets.

spells.name: Victory Rush
spells.description: Instantly attack the target causing 15% of Attack Power damage and healing you for 10% of your maximum health. Only useable within 20 sec after you kill a non-trivial enemy.

spells.name: Whirlwind
spells.description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.
